notes.title: Brr Brr Patapim is in the game!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have released an update that adds a new character to the game!

[h1]Brr Brr Patapim[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611739/fea58e72c7472a3b7af8899e84dc5dc104b5b36d.png[/img]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
Lirili Larila:
1. Reduced the amount of xp for laril lyrely laril
2. Increased damage from combo attacks
3. changed the buttons of one combo attack

Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur:
1. Increased damage from combo attacks
2. Increased attack speed for normal strikes

Trippi Troppi:
1. changed the buttons for combo strikes
2. Increased damage for two combo attacks
3. Reduced the damage for one of the combo attacks

Tralalero Tralala:
1. Increased damage for all combo attacks
2. Changed the buttons for combo strikes

Chimpanzini Bananini:
1. Reduced damage for one combo attack

Bombardiro Crocodilo:
1. Reduced size on combo attacks when the character was getting bigger and interfering with the view

[h1]Fix[/h1]
Added smooth transition from death animation to combat stance.

notes.title: Balance and fixes!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p]Hello everyone!   

We have released an update that has changed the balance so that there are no obviously strong or obviously weak characters. [/p][h1]

List of changes[/h1][p]
Trippy trope:
1. Slowed down the attack speed from Trippy Troppy's foot attack  
2. Speeded up ultimates attack animation and increased damage    

Tralalero Tralala:  
1. Increased ultimates attack speed  S
2. Increased damage from normal strikes  
3. Reduced damage from ultimates  
4. Increased damage for combo attacks  
5. Attack speed for combo attacks increased   [/p][p]Capibarelo kokosini:  
1. Increased attack speed for ultimates  
2. Increased damage from normal attacks  
3. Increased damage from ultimates    

Lirili Laryl:  
1. Increased attack speed for normal attacks  
2. Increased attack speed for ultimates  
3. Increased damage from normal head attack  
4. Increased attack speed for combo hits   

Boneka Ambalabu:  
1. Increased attack speed for normal attacks  
2. Increased attack speed for combo strikes  
3. Increased attack speed for ultimates  
4. Reduced damage from ultimates    [/p][p][/p][p]Bombardiro crocodile:  
1. changed the attack speeds for normal hits, for combo hits, and for ultimates [/p][p][/p][h1]
Fixes[/h1][p]
The ability to go off-map with jumping has also been fixed. [/p]

notes.title: Release date and UI update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! Today we're going to talk about the news on the game.

[/p][h1]Game Release[/h1][p] We are happy to announce that Brainrot Animals Fighting will be released on July 3 at 13:00 EST! Add the game to your wishlist to get a release notification.
